title: ndeimler99/TArPON
description: Telomere Analysis Pipeline On Nanopore Sequencing Data

outdir.title: Output Directory
outdir.help_text: This should be a path to a directory to store the output data. The parent directory should exist. If the main directory does not exist it will be created

overwrite_outdir.title: Overwrite Output Directory?
overwrite_outdir.help_text: Set this to true if the output directory already exists but you would like to overwrite the data

repeat.title: Telomeric Repeat Sequence (G-Strand)
repeat.help_text: Please supply the telomeric sequence found on the G strand, for examples and most vertebrata, GGTTAG

minimum_telo_reads_per_sample.title: Minimum Number of Telomeres Per Sample
minimum_telo_reads_per_sample.help_text: Samples will be marked as failed if minimum number of telomeres is below this threshold

c_strand_only.title: C Strand Analysis Only
c_strand_only.help_text: If the data was collected in such a way that only C strand telomeric sequences should be expected (i.e. ONT protocol), select this box

Adaptor Sequence Identification.title: Adaptor Sequence Identification
Adaptor Sequence Identification.description: Parameters relatig to the identification of a capture sequence on the end of the telomeres

adaptor_sequence.title: Telomere Capture Sequence
adaptor_sequence.help_text: Provide the first 12 nucleotides of the capture sequence that would appear on the G strand telomeric sequences

adaptor_sequence_errors.title: Adaptor Sequence Errors
adaptor_sequence_errors.help_text: Maximum number of errors allowed in the adaptor sequence when identifying the end of telomeric sequences

Subtelomeric Filtering.title: Subtelomeric Filtering Parameters
Subtelomeric Filtering.description: Parameters relatig to filtering telomeric reads by the length of sequence before the telomeric start site

min_subtelo_length.title: Minimum Subtelomere Length
min_subtelo_length.help_text: Minimum Read Lenth Before VRR region Telomeric Start Site to Ensure sequencing completely through telomeres

subtelo_threshold.title: Maximum Telomeric Percentage
subtelo_threshold.help_text: Maximum percentage of one nucleotide substitutions of telomeric sequences found within min_subtelo_length before read does not pass filtering criteria
